method: Interactive browser inspection of the public corrected Cloud Run frontend without signing in

observations.detail: Trending button populated the form. Score it displayed five cards; first crowd 3.1%, model 6.0%, difference +2.8 pp; second crowd 93.5%, model 90.7%.
Charts identify the dashed line as the current estimate, not a historical model forecast.
Expanded panel explicitly warns that the model performed worse than the crowd.
Narrow cards stack probabilities, text and charts remain readable, no horizontal clipping observed. Desktop cards show probabilities side by side. Temporary viewport override reset.

observations.message: Use a polymarket.com event or market link, or paste its event slug.

scope: Point-in-time observations of the corrected hosted app; prices and upstream availability can change. No trades placed.
